generation.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE independently painted2D HERO SPECIALTY ICON MASTER for ORIGINAL Heroes of Might and Magic III, to be reduced to44x44 and32x32 game icons. The supplied original UN44/UN32 extracted native icon board is rendering/framing guidance ONLY; paint entirely new pixels, do not crop/paste original sprites. Match their compact hand-painted tactile miniature objects, strong silhouette and simple centered readable motif occupying80% of square, short dramatic upper-left warm light, definite shadows, aged brass/ivory/navy materials, controlled color and richly painted dark warm-brown stone/cloth backing. This is a physical painted medieval-fantasy/early-artificer emblem, not flat vector, app logo, glossy3D render, modern splash art, neon hologram or abstract diagram.
